start.speaker: Narrator
start.text: At first it is a whisper—an almost imperceptible rasp along the edges of the world. The air tightens, and clocks in the distance bow like exhausted watchers.

TBD2.speaker: Narrator
TBD2.text: Moments peel away quietly: laughter thins into static, footsteps skip like broken recordings, and the sky drains until only a humming emptiness remains.

TBD3.speaker: Narrator
TBD3.text: You feel the weight of a tiny choice—a toggled setting called TimeBoxed mode—and understand, too late, how brittle the seam between then and now was. Under the strain it unstitched.

TBD4.speaker: Narrator
TBD4.text: Light folds into hollow shapes. The box that bore you hums like a hollow bone. Memories slacken; promises fray. A soft, dreadful cracking echoes where the world once held together.

TBD5.speaker: Narrator
TBD5.text: No thunder, no accusations—only the mechanic logic of collapse. TimeBoxed mode gnawed at the weave until it gave. The universe does not scold; it simply empties.

end.speaker: Narrator
end.text: Silence arrives like a room bereft of furniture. The sky is a blank; the stars are pinpricks of teeth. There is no comfort here—only a hollow that looks back at you. The game will restart. You will begin again.
